# alpine:3.20
FROM registry.example.test/library/alpine@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa AS certs
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates=20250911-r0

# golang:1.27-alpine
FROM registry.example.test/library/golang@sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb AS base
WORKDIR /src

FROM base AS ci
RUN apk add --no-cache git=2.49.1-r0 tzdata=2025b-r0

FROM base AS builder
COPY . .
RUN go build -o /out/service .

FROM scratch
COPY --from=certs /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/
COPY --from=builder /out/service /service
USER 65532:65532
ENTRYPOINT ["/service"]
